events.title: Simon Höfele & Orchestre Philharmonique Royal de Liège
program: Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart: Ouvertüre zu »Die Entführung aus dem Serail« KV 384
Joseph Haydn: Konzert für Trompete und Orchester Es-Dur Hob. VIIe:1
events.intro: Trumpeter Simon Höfele joins the Orchestre Philharmonique Royal de Liège and conductor David Reiland for an Advent concert featuring Haydn's Trumpet Concerto in E-flat major alongside Mozart's overture to 'Die Entführung aus dem Serail' and Rimsky-Korsakov's colorful orchestral suite 'Scheherazade'.

events.title: Rock the Ballet
events.intro: An explosive fusion of world-class ballet technique, acrobatics, and modern street dance set to iconic rock and pop songs. Created by Rasta Thomas and choreographer Adrienne Canterna, the show has thrilled millions of audiences worldwide.

events.title: Sir Simon Rattle & BR-Symphonieorchester – Beethoven Eroica
program: Francesco Filidei: Konzert für Viola und Orchester
Ludwig van Beethoven: Sinfonie Nr. 3 Es-Dur op. 55 »Eroica«
events.intro: Antoine Tamestit, Curating Artist of the 2026/27 season, performs Francesco Filidei's viola concerto alongside Beethoven's iconic 'Eroica' Symphony with the Symphonieorchester des Bayerischen Rundfunks under Sir Simon Rattle. The program pairs a 2024-premiered contemporary work with one of the most beloved symphonies in the repertoire.

events.title: Weihnachtskonzert 2026 der Chorakademie
performers: Chöre der Chorakademie am Konzerthaus Dortmund (choir)
events.intro: Die Chöre der Chorakademie am Konzerthaus Dortmund präsentieren im traditionellen Weihnachtskonzert festliche Lieder im Advent – eine fröhliche Einstimmung auf Weihnachten für die ganze Familie.

events.title: Antoine Tamestit & SWR Ensemble – Schalom Alechem
program: Sergei Prokofiev: Ouvertüre über hebräische Themen (arr. Anton Hollich)
Béla Kovács: Klezmer-inspiriertes Stück (arr. Anton Hollich)
events.intro: Antoine Tamestit leads the audience through the world of Jewish music – from Ernest Bloch's intimate pieces to exhilarating Klezmer dances – together with soloists of the SWR Symphonieorchester, with arrangements by ensemble member Anton Hollich. The concert is part of the festival 'Antoine Tamestit & Friends' at Konzerthaus Dortmund.
